trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Collect luggage and take the Ramada Kissimmee Gateway free theme park shuttle or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to the hotel. Check in, unpack essentials, and review your Disney World park tickets and plans for the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at a nearby 24-hour Denny's (~1 mile from hotel) or pick up snacks at a nearby Walmart Supercenter on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy to stock up for the week

day_by_day.notes: Pro tip: Stop at Walmart or Publix near the hotel tonight or first thing tomorrow to stock up on breakfast items, snacks, and drinks for the room. This can save $50-$100+ over the week. Make sure park tickets are linked in the My Disney Experience app before bed.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Magic Kingdom — the most iconic Disney park. Use the hotel's free theme park shuttle (check schedule at front desk, typically departs every 30-60 min). Arrive early (park opening ~9:00 AM) to beat crowds. Hit top rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane if budget allows. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Liberty Square and Haunted Mansion, then head to Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean. Take a break during peak heat (1-3 PM) at an air-conditioned attraction like the Hall of Presidents or Carousel of Progress. Grab a mid-afternoon snack and rest your feet.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular — the 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks show (typically around 9:00 PM, check app for exact time). Find a good spot on Main Street U.S.A. about 30-45 minutes early. Take the free shuttle back to the hotel after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast at the hotel or from room snacks purchased at Walmart to save money
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly counter service with fish and chips, clam chowder, and sandwiches (~$12-16 per person)
meals.dinner: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Cafe in Frontierland — counter service Tex-Mex with a free toppings bar to bulk up your meal (~$13-17 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Bring a refillable water bottle — Disney has free water cup stations at all quick-service restaurants. Wear comfortable shoes and apply sunscreen. June in Orlando is hot and humid with afternoon thunderstorms common — pack a small poncho.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT via the hotel shuttle. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Start in World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (book Individual Lightning Lane in advance on the app at 7 AM) and Test Track. Then head to World Nature for Soarin' Around the World.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase — walk through the international pavilions (Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, UK, Canada). Each pavilion has free entertainment, cultural exhibits, and unique architecture. Catch a live cultural performance. Visit the Mexico pavilion's Gran Fiesta Tour boat ride (free with park admission).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check app for current show name and time, typically ~9:00 PM). Grab a budget-friendly snack from one of the World Showcase kiosks. Take the shuttle back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Room breakfast from Walmart supplies (cereal, fruit, granola bars)
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best value counter-service spots with rotating seasonal dishes, sandwiches, and salads (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: Regal Eagle Smokehouse in the American Adventure pavilion — counter-service BBQ with pulled pork, brisket, and mac & cheese (~$14-18 per person)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a large park — wear comfortable shoes. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for Future World/World Discovery rides. Stay hydrated — free water cups are available at all quick-service locations.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning — sleep in! This is a great day to use the hotel pool, do laundry, and recharge. Head to the nearby International Drive area or browse the Kissimmee strip for budget souvenirs. Visit the Walmart Supercenter to restock snacks and drinks for the room.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Disney Springs — Disney's free shopping, dining, and entertainment district (no park ticket required). Explore the shops, browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), watch street performers, and enjoy the atmosphere. Check out the LEGO Store with its giant outdoor LEGO sculptures. Browse the Marketplace Co-Op for unique Disney merchandise.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner and entertainment at Disney Springs. Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater if desired (~$15-20 per ticket) or enjoy the free live music performances around the waterfront. Take the hotel shuttle back (Disney Springs has its own shuttle stop from many Kissimmee hotels).

meals.breakfast: Sleep in — brunch from room supplies or a nearby IHOP or Denny's on US-192 (~$10-14 per person)
meals.lunch: Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs — one of the best value meals near Disney with hot sandwiches for ~$8-10 per person
meals.dinner: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — build-your-own pizza for ~$10-13 per person, or grab food from the Marketplace food trucks

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to experience Disney magic without using a park ticket. Parking is also free if driving. This rest day is important for a 7-day trip — your feet will thank you!

day_by_day.morning: Head to Hollywood Studios via the hotel shuttle. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Make a beeline for Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first (shorter wait at opening). Then get in line or use Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance, one of Disney's most impressive attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then head to Sunset Boulevard for Rock 'n' Roller Coaster and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (check app for times). Visit the Animation Courtyard for Star Wars Launch Bay.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check app for showtimes, typically 8:00 or 9:00 PM). Arrive 45-60 minutes early for good seats — it's a popular show. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Room breakfast to save money before a big park day
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — counter service with grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts, and totchos (~$11-15 per person)
meals.dinner: Backlot Express near Echo Lake — counter service burgers, chicken, and sandwiches in a fun movie prop setting (~$12-16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the busiest parks — arrive early and use the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times and grab Lightning Lane selections strategically. The park can get very crowded on summer Fridays.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Animal Kingdom via the hotel shuttle. Arrive at rope drop (~8:00 AM — Animal Kingdom often opens early). Rush to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (one of Disney's most popular rides — waits can exceed 2 hours). Then ride Na'vi River Journey nearby.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — ride Kilimanjaro Safaris in the early afternoon when animals are more active. Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing. Head to Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet — great for a hot June day!). Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for 'Rivers of Light' or the current nighttime spectacular at Animal Kingdom (check app — show availability varies). Explore the Tree of Life as it lights up at night. Take the shuttle back to the hotel. Tonight is a great night to pack for checkout and organize souvenirs.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick snack from room supplies before heading out early
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of Disney's best counter-service values with BBQ ribs, chicken, and pulled pork with scenic waterfront seating (~$13-17 per person)
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — counter service with healthy grain bowls, noodle bowls, and unique Avatar-themed food (~$13-17 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. Bring a change of clothes or a poncho if you plan to ride Kali River Rapids. The park is also very walkable with beautiful nature trails that are free to explore.

day_by_day.morning: Check out of the hotel (standard checkout is 11:00 AM — ask about late checkout if needed). If your flight is in the afternoon or evening, store luggage at the hotel front desk. Take one last trip to a nearby park or spend the morning at the hotel pool. Alternatively, visit the nearby Old Town Kissimmee (free admission) on US-192 for last-minute souvenir shopping at budget-friendly prices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the airport via hotel shuttle or rideshare (allow 45-60 minutes travel time to Orlando International Airport, plus 2 hours before your flight for security). Browse airport shops for any last-minute Disney souvenirs — or skip it and save money! Grab a meal at the airport before your flight.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando — reflect on an amazing week at Disney World! Review your My Disney Experience app for any photos taken on Disney PhotoPass if you purchased it.

meals.breakfast: Finish remaining room snacks or grab a quick breakfast at the hotel or nearby McDonald's/Dunkin' on US-192 (~$5-8 per person)
meals.lunch: Old Town Kissimmee food vendors or a quick-service restaurant on US-192 before heading to the airport (~$10-14 per person)
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport — Chick-fil-A, Burger King, or local options in the terminal (~$12-18 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Budget Summary Tips for the Week: 1) Use the hotel's free shuttle daily to save on transportation. 2) Stock the room with Walmart groceries for breakfasts and snacks (~$50-75 for the week). 3) Stick to counter-service dining at parks (~$12-17/meal vs $30-60+ for table service). 4) Bring refillable water bottles — free water is available at all Disney quick-service locations. 5) Download the My Disney Experience app and check wait times to maximize your time. 6) Look for Disney ticket discounts through AAA, military, Florida resident deals, or Undercover Tourist before your trip. Estimated total food budget for the week: $400-600 for a family of 4 using these tips.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Take the Ramada free theme park shuttle or a rideshare to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and settle into your room. Pick up any essentials at a nearby 24-hour Walmart or Walgreens on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Grab a late-night bite at a nearby fast-casual spot such as Denny's or IHOP on US-192 (open 24 hours), both within a short drive of the hotel

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light – rest is essential after a late arrival. Confirm your Disney park tickets and Lightning Lane reservations for the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if you haven't already. Set an early alarm for Day 2 to maximize park time.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day – Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Use the hotel's free theme park shuttle departing around 7:45–8:00 AM. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Book Lightning Lane passes for high-demand rides early via the app.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Ride Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (typically ~3:00 PM). Grab a mid-afternoon snack and rest in the shade during peak heat hours (1:00–3:00 PM).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom Fireworks Spectacular – 'Disney Enchantment' (typically ~9:00 PM). Watch from Main Street U.S.A. for the best views. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the hotel or pick up pastries and coffee at Main Street Bakery inside Magic Kingdom
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – mid-range counter service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and sandwiches (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland (book in advance) for a mid-range sit-down experience, or Tony's Town Square Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. (~$20–$35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a refillable water bottle, and a light rain poncho (June is Florida's rainy season). Arrive at the shuttle stop 15 minutes early. Purchase a MagicBand+ if desired for a more seamless park experience.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM) and start with Future World / World Discovery. Ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines build. Use Lightning Lane for Remy's Ratatouille Adventure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to World Showcase (opens ~11:00 AM). Stroll through all 11 country pavilions – Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample small bites and drinks from multiple pavilions as a progressive food tour. Don't miss the Norway pavilion's Frozen Ever After ride.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (~9:00 PM). Find a spot along the lagoon promenade 30 minutes early for the best view. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Hotel continental breakfast or a quick stop at Starbucks inside EPCOT's World Discovery area
meals.lunch: World Showcase progressive lunch – grab a Ropa Vieja empanada in Mexico, a School Bread pastry in Norway, and a Teriyaki chicken skewer in Japan (~$8–$15 per stop, budget ~$25–$35 total)
meals.dinner: Spice Road Table in the Morocco pavilion – Mediterranean small plates with a lagoon view, perfect for watching the evening show (~$20–$35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large – wear comfortable shoes. The World Showcase is ideal for adults and older kids; younger children will enjoy the Kidcot Fun Stops at each pavilion. Check the EPCOT app for any special festival events running in June (EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival sometimes begins in late summer).

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Take the hotel shuttle for an early arrival (~8:30 AM). Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Batuu. Book a time slot for Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run via Lightning Lane. If budget allows, reserve Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (approximately $249.99 – optional splurge).
day_by_day.afternoon: Ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive experiences – book Lightning Lane first thing). Explore the Droid Depot, Oga's Cantina (reservations recommended), and browse the themed merchandise. Transition to other Hollywood Studios highlights: Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land and Tower of Terror.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check schedule, typically 8:00 or 9:00 PM). Arrive 45–60 minutes early for good seating. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the hotel or Backlot Express inside Hollywood Studios (counter service burgers and wraps, ~$12–$16)
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge – themed Star Wars cuisine like Smoked Kaadu Ribs or Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – a unique mid-range sit-down experience where you dine in retro cars watching classic sci-fi movie clips (~$20–$35 per person, reservations recommended)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the busiest parks – arrive early and prioritize Lightning Lane reservations. Savi's Workshop requires advance reservations and is a premium experience. Oga's Cantina has a 45-minute seating limit and serves both alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. Check the My Disney Experience app for show times.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage. Take the hotel shuttle for rope drop (~8:00 AM). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride – Lightning Lane essential). The early morning light in Pandora is stunning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Walk over to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari (best in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active – if you missed it, go now). Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, and more in a realistic savanna setting. Explore Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close animal encounters. Catch the 'Festival of the Lion King' live show (check schedule).
day_by_day.evening: Experience the 'Rivers of Light' or 'Tree of Life Awakening' nighttime experience as the park winds down. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (~8:00–9:00 PM). Return to the hotel via shuttle and enjoy a relaxed evening at the hotel pool or nearby restaurant on US-192.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the hotel before departure, or Starbucks at Animal Kingdom's entrance plaza
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – one of Disney's best counter-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls and unique Avatar-themed dishes (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia – Asian-fusion sit-down dining with dishes like Crispy Honey Chicken and Kobe Beef Burger (~$20–$35 per person, reservations recommended), or head back to Kissimmee for dinner at a local restaurant on US-192

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active and temperatures are cooler. Wear light, breathable clothing. The park has significant walking on uneven terrain. Na'vi River Journey in Pandora is a gentler alternative to Flight of Passage for younger or less thrill-seeking family members.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely hotel breakfast. Take the hotel shuttle or a short rideshare to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required). Explore the Marketplace area, browse unique shops like World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), and check out LEGO Store with its outdoor LEGO sculptures.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy free street entertainment and live music performances throughout Disney Springs. Visit the Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling and entertainment (mid-range pricing, ~$20–$25 per person per game). Explore the Town Center and West Side areas. If traveling with kids, check out the interactive water fountain play area near the Marketplace.
day_by_day.evening: Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater or enjoy live music at one of the outdoor venues. Disney Springs has a vibrant nightlife atmosphere with street performers and musicians. Return to the hotel at a relaxed pace – this is your recovery day before the final park day.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a leisurely meal at First Watch or Perkins on US-192 near the hotel
meals.lunch: The Polite Pig at Disney Springs – award-winning BBQ with smoked meats, craft cocktails, and sides (~$15–$22 per person, counter service style)
meals.dinner: Raglan Road Irish Pub & Restaurant at Disney Springs – lively atmosphere with live Irish music, dancing, and hearty pub fare like fish and chips or shepherd's pie (~$20–$35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great budget-friendly day. Parking is also free in the Disney Springs garages. This day is intentionally lighter to rest your feet before the final park day. Consider booking any last-minute dining reservations for the week or purchasing Disney souvenirs at competitive prices at the World of Disney store.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park or explore any missed highlights. Recommended: Return to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for any rides or experiences you missed earlier in the week. Alternatively, use this morning for a final leisurely breakfast and pool time at the hotel if you have an afternoon or evening flight. Check out of the hotel and store luggage at the front desk if needed.
day_by_day.afternoon: If staying in the area: Visit ICON Park on International Drive (~15 minutes away) for The Wheel (giant observation wheel with great views of Orlando) and Madame Tussauds – a more budget-friendly alternative to a full park day (~$25–$40 per person). Or spend time shopping for last-minute souvenirs on US-192 (many discount souvenir shops near the hotel).
day_by_day.evening: Head to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. Use the hotel shuttle or book a rideshare in advance. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in and security. Reflect on an incredible week at Disney World!

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast or a sit-down meal at Cracker Barrel on US-192 – a classic American comfort food experience (~$10–$15 per person)
meals.lunch: If visiting ICON Park: Tin Roof Orlando on International Drive – live music venue with American comfort food and a fun atmosphere (~$15–$25 per person). If at a Disney park: any favorite counter-service spot from the week
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport, or an early dinner before heading to the airport at a local favorite like Olive Garden or Texas Roadhouse on US-192 (~$15–$25 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure flight time and arrange transportation to the airport well in advance. The hotel's free shuttle may not service the airport – confirm with the front desk and book a rideshare or taxi if needed. Allow extra time for Sunday airport traffic. Don't forget to check all hotel rooms for left-behind items before checkout. Consider purchasing any remaining Disney merchandise at Disney Springs or on shopDisney.com to avoid heavy luggage.

meals.dinner: Late-night arrival – grab a light bite at the hotel or a nearby late-night spot such as Denny's (open 24 hrs, 2 min drive) or order room service if available

day_by_day.notes: Pack light carry-on essentials for easy late-night check-in. Confirm shuttle schedule with the hotel in advance or pre-book a private luxury car service (e.g., Mears Connect Black Car) for a seamless arrival. Get to bed early – big park days start tomorrow!

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day – Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Use the hotel's free theme park shuttle (departs ~8:00 AM). Hit the top-tier attractions first: Space Mountain, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (book Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance), and Pirates of the Caribbean. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland before crowds build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration. Experience Haunted Mansion, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and the Festival of Fantasy Parade (typically ~3:00 PM). Take a mid-afternoon break at a shaded area or a sit-down restaurant to recharge. Use Lightning Lane Individual selections for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train if not done in the morning.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular TRON Lightcycle / Run (book Lightning Lane early). Secure a premium viewing spot for the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular (typically ~9:00 PM). Enjoy the Main Street Electrical Parade if running. Return to hotel via shuttle after the fireworks.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel before shuttle departure – or grab a quick bite at Main Street Bakery (Starbucks) inside Magic Kingdom upon arrival
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Beauty and the Beast themed, table service) – book in advance via My Disney Experience app; try the French onion soup and braised pork
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table (inside Cinderella Castle) – a premium, character dining experience with prix-fixe menu; book 60 days in advance; enjoy filet mignon or pan-seared salmon with castle views

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Disney Genie+ and Lightning Lane selections the moment the park opens at 7:00 AM via the My Disney Experience app. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, hats, and a portable fan – June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+). Stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT (opens ~9:00 AM). Begin with Future World / World Discovery: experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane – book immediately at 7:00 AM), Test Track, and Soarin' Around the World. These are best tackled early before lines grow.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to the World Showcase Lagoon (opens ~11:00 AM). Embark on a self-guided premium food and culture tour across all 11 country pavilions. Must-try stops: Mexico (La Cava del Tequila – premium margaritas and guacamole), Japan (Katsura Grill – teriyaki and sushi), France (Les Halles Boulangerie – croissants and crème brûlée), and Morocco (spiced lamb flatbread). Explore artisan shops and cultural exhibits in each pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival (if running in June – confirm dates) for additional global tastings. Watch the stunning EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (~9:00 PM). Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or quick stop at Sunshine Seasons (EPCOT's The Land pavilion) – fresh smoothies, pastries, and hot breakfast options
meals.lunch: Chefs de France (France Pavilion, World Showcase) – authentic French cuisine with croque monsieur, bouillabaisse, and crème brûlée in an elegant Parisian bistro setting
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo (Japan Pavilion) – premium teppanyaki dining with hibachi-grilled wagyu beef, lobster, and theatrical tableside cooking; book 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most walkable park – wear comfortable shoes. The World Showcase is enormous; consider renting an ECV or stroller for younger children. La Cava del Tequila is walk-up only – arrive early or expect a wait. Guardians of the Galaxy virtual queue fills instantly – set an alarm for 7:00 AM.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Take the hotel shuttle for early park entry (~8:00 AM). Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Batuu. First priority: Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run (shorter waits at opening). Then visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (premium experience, ~$250/person – book 60 days in advance via My Disney Experience). This is a once-in-a-lifetime immersive experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most technologically advanced rides – use Lightning Lane Individual). Explore the Droid Depot to build a custom droid (~$120). Grab a Blue or Green Milk from the Milk Stand. Then venture to other Hollywood Studios highlights: Tower of Terror, Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith, and Toy Story Land's Slinky Dog Dash.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check show times). Stay for the breathtaking Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks and projection show (~9:30 PM) – one of Disney's most impressive nighttime shows. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Early hotel breakfast before shuttle or Woody's Lunch Box (Toy Story Land) – toasted cheese sandwiches and s'mores French toast
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge) – the most immersive bar/lounge in Disney; enjoy themed cocktails (alcoholic and non-alcoholic), Batuu-inspired bites, and DJ R-3X; reservations required
meals.dinner: The Hollywood Brown Derby (Hollywood Studios) – Disney's most upscale Hollywood Studios restaurant; enjoy the signature Cobb salad, pan-seared duck breast, and grapefruit cake in a 1930s Hollywood glamour setting; book 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations are extremely limited and sell out fast – book exactly 60 days before your trip at 7:00 AM EST. The lightsaber experience takes ~20 minutes and is deeply immersive. Oga's Cantina has a 45-minute time limit per visit. Hollywood Studios is one of the busiest parks – arrive early and use Genie+ aggressively.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage – Take the hotel shuttle for early park entry. Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (Lightning Lane Individual – book at 7:00 AM; this is consistently Disney's most in-demand ride). The experience is breathtaking – a simulated banshee flight over Pandora's bioluminescent landscape.
day_by_day.afternoon: After Pandora, head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari (best in morning/early afternoon for active animals). Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos, and crocodiles in a realistic savanna setting. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail. Experience Expedition Everest – Legend of the Forbidden Mountain (Lightning Lane Multi Pass). Visit the Tree of Life and It's Tough to Be a Bug! show.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (check if running) or the Tree of Life Awakenings projection show at dusk – magical and serene. Dine at a premium Animal Kingdom restaurant before heading back. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – Disney's most acclaimed Animal Kingdom restaurant; enjoy a leisurely breakfast or arrive for an early lunch; features globally inspired cuisine with artwork from Disney's worldwide expeditions
meals.lunch: Yak & Yeti Restaurant (Asia, Animal Kingdom) – pan-Asian cuisine with honey chicken, ahi tuna nachos, and mango pie in a richly decorated two-story setting; table service
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – return for dinner if not visited at breakfast; signature dishes include whole-fried sustainable fish, braised short rib, and a stunning charcuterie board; one of Disney's finest dining experiences

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 8:00–9:00 PM). Plan your day accordingly. The Kilimanjaro Safari is best in the morning when animals are most active. Na'vi River Journey in Pandora is a gentler, beautiful boat ride – great for all ages. Bring insect repellent – Animal Kingdom is more outdoorsy and humid.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Start with a relaxed morning at the hotel (sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast). Head to Disney Springs mid-morning via the free hotel shuttle. Explore the vibrant shopping, dining, and entertainment complex at your own pace. Visit the LEGO Store (massive interactive displays), World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), and Art of Disney gallery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy Disney Springs' free entertainment: live street performers, musicians, and character meet-and-greets. Visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for premium bowling and billiards (great for families). Explore the Disney Springs Marketplace and Town Center. Browse upscale boutiques including Kate Spade, Pandora, and Anthropologie. Kids can enjoy the splash pad and outdoor play areas.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a premium dinner at one of Disney Springs' acclaimed restaurants. After dinner, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 (IMAX or premium large format) or enjoy a cocktail at a rooftop bar. Return to hotel at leisure.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast – take advantage of a relaxed morning; alternatively, visit The Polite Pig (Disney Springs) for brunch with craft cocktails and smoked meats
meals.lunch: Morimoto Asia (Disney Springs) – Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship restaurant; enjoy dim sum, Peking duck, and sushi in a stunning two-story space; one of the best restaurants in all of Disney Springs
meals.dinner: STK Orlando (Disney Springs) – upscale modern steakhouse with USDA prime cuts, truffle fries, and an extensive wine list; rooftop terrace dining available; perfect for a premium family dinner

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter – no park ticket required. This is a great day to rest your feet after four consecutive park days. Splitsville requires reservations on weekends. STK and Morimoto Asia are very popular – book well in advance. Disney Springs is open until 11:00 PM, making it perfect for a relaxed evening.

day_by_day.morning: Return to EPCOT or Magic Kingdom for any missed experiences, OR enjoy a premium resort morning. If returning to a park: use this final day to revisit favorite rides, complete any Lightning Lane experiences you missed, and pick up last-minute souvenirs. Alternatively, enjoy the hotel pool, spa services (if available), or a leisurely breakfast before checkout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final afternoon at Disney Springs for last-minute souvenir shopping and a farewell lunch. Visit the Disney flagship store for exclusive merchandise. Consider a premium experience like the Bibbidi Bobbidi Boutique (for younger children – princess/knight makeovers) if not done earlier. Begin packing and prepare for departure.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a premium Orlando restaurant near the hotel or at Disney Springs. Arrange airport transfer (private car service recommended for a luxury departure). Depart for Orlando International Airport with magical memories.

meals.breakfast: Grand breakfast at the hotel – treat yourself to a full American breakfast with fresh-squeezed juice, eggs benedict, and pastries to fuel the final day
meals.lunch: Wine Bar George (Disney Springs) – America's only Master Sommelier-led restaurant at a theme park; enjoy artisan cheese boards, flatbreads, and an exceptional wine selection; perfect for a relaxed farewell lunch
meals.dinner: The Boathouse (Disney Springs) – waterfront fine dining with fresh seafood, prime steaks, and classic American cuisine; enjoy outdoor seating on the water with views of vintage amphicars; a perfect farewell dinner

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time (typically 11:00 AM) and arrange luggage storage if your flight is in the evening. Pre-book your airport transfer the night before. The Boathouse offers amphicar tours of the Disney Springs waterway – a unique premium experience worth booking. Leave time for a final stroll through Disney Springs before heading to the airport. Tip: purchase any last Disney gift cards or merchandise before leaving – they make great gifts!

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June
